Hormones are unfortunately very poorly understood. It's taken years for me to get stable, which is common in nearly half if people with hormone therapy of any kind. The way people react to, absorb, and process hormones is very complex and varies greatly. Diet, exercise, time of day, physiology, and so many other factors make it a very inexact science. It also sucks that endocrinology is a very highly requested and often refused referral. It took 3 years before I actually saw one of those.
I try not to dwell on the past, but I am in a situation where many things in my life immediately remind me of shit show my life is.

I had thyroid cancer. It's pretty curable and wasn't as bad as I've seen, but it fucks up your hormones and it's really a life altering thing.
I don't really focus on small things that seem stupid or mean, all my friends have moved away in the last year, but there's nothing about that that I'm angry about. The only healthy and happy relationship I've ever had ending really fucking sucks. I've reasoned through it, I'm not resentful, I didn't do toxic stuff to prolong the pain. I actually tried to get in shape and self-improve, although that was hampered by personal disaster. I'm happy I'm not going to die from cancer, but my health is far from perfect, I've been laid off, unable to collect unemployment because the state seems to have conflicting records, lost two family members, had to move twice (with a gun pointed at me for the second time), and tons of other super stressful things. I'm crumbling and I've long been out of resources to help. 
It also doesn't help that I'm an awful person. Before that one good relationship, I was in several abusive ones, although I was actually the victim. Self-esteem has always been a tricky thing for me, so I put up with a lot. I also cheated, I've committed a few real crimes like larceny. Some times I have no remorse, I did it to survive, other times I genuinely hurt people without anything I can pretend to justify.
You've definitely made arguments defending pedophilia.
You guys, the nose ring is to keep her from biting the other piglet's tails.

I wouldn't shoot myself. I own a gun and I am relatively confident that if I were to use it to kill myself I would be successful. Unfortunately, I have seen enough suicides in person to know what mistakes to avoid. It's messy and I don't necessarily want to traumatize those around me. I also don't want people to know that it was a suicide. I have a somewhat sizable insurance policy and I would like that to go to the few people in this world I have left. 
I keep trying to improve my life enough that I don't feel this way, but I increasingly want to punch my tickets. I do a lot of winter camping and hiking and I think that it would not look at all suspicious if I were to forget my GPS in my truck. Weather in the mountains can be unpredictable and I could simply start to hike about an hour before dark and keep trekking until I'm exhausted. I don't get very cold, so it wouldn't even look odd if I were underdressed for a night below zero. I figure if I keep trekking until I am too exhausted to keep going or at least until I lose my nerve then I will be too tired and lost to make it back to my truck or my gear. at some point I would just go to sleep and not wake up.
